The Namecheap guarantee is our mark of excellence.</p> </div>  </div>  <div class=gb-collapse>  <div class=gb-collapse__trigger data-et-category="New homepage" data-et-action="FAQ - Dropdown - " data-et-label="Why is domain name registration required?" data-et-customhandler=homePage.faqDropdown> <span class=gb-text-bold>Why is domain name registration required?</span> </div>   <div class="gb-collapse__content gb-pl-3"> <p>When you build a website, you want visitors to come and see what you've done. To get them there, you need a unique domain name that connects to your site's servers. Domain name registration is required to ensure that no one else in the world can claim ownership of your site's address and to make finding your website simple. <a href="https://www.namecheap.com/domains/domain-name-search/" data-et-category="New homepage" data-et-action="FAQ - Dropdown - Link" data-et-label="/domains/domain-name-search/">Find your one of a kind domain name.</a></p> </div>  </div>  <div class=gb-collapse>  <div class=gb-collapse__trigger data-et-category="New homepage" data-et-action="FAQ - Dropdown - " data-et-label="How does domain registration work?" data-et-customhandler=homePage.faqDropdown> <span class=gb-text-bold>How does domain registration work?</span> </div>   <div class="gb-collapse__content gb-pl-3"> <p>Think of the name you want to register. The answer is typically your company or website name. It is best to keep your domain name short and easy to understand. Say it out loud, and make sure it sounds great. Next, search to see if it is available. If the name you desire is taken with the .com top-level domain, there are hundreds of others available.     <section id="no-cdn-access" aria-hidden="true" style="display: none;"></section>
    <script type="text/html" id="no-cdn-access-content">
        <style>
            #no-cdn-access {
                padding-top: 24px;
                padding-bottom: 200px;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                color: #6d6e70;
                font-family: Museo Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
                font-size: 1rem;
                font-weight: 300;
                line-height: 1.5;
                text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
                text-align: center;
            }

            #no-cdn-access .headline__heading3 {
                display: block;
                font-size: 1.17em;
                margin-block-start: 1em;
                margin-block-end: 1em;
                margin-inline-start: 0;
                margin-inline-end: 0;
                font-weight: bold;
            }

            #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__logos {
                display: flex;
                flex: auto;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
            }

            #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__logos div {
                margin-right: 50px;
            }

            #no-cdn-access a, a:focus, a:hover {
                text-decoration: none;
            }

            #no-cdn-access p {
                margin: 0 0 1.5em;
            }

            #no-cdn-access .headline {
                font-size: 1.5rem;
                line-height: 1.33;
                text-align: center;
            }

            #no-cdn-access .headline__title {
                margin-bottom: 20px;
                font-size: 1.5rem;
                line-height: 1.125;
                font-weight: bold;
            }

            #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__actions-headlines {
                display: block;
                font-size: 1.5em;
                margin-block-start: 0.83em;
                margin-block-end: 0.83em;
                margin-inline-start: 0;
                margin-inline-end: 0;
                font-weight: bold;
            }

            #no-cdn-access dl,
            #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__contac-support,
            #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__actions-headlines {
                padding: 0 15px;
                text-align: left;
            }

            #no-cdn-access dl dt {
                font-weight: 600;
            }

            #no-cdn-access dl * {
                line-height: 1.8rem;
            }

            #no-cdn-access ul {
                margin: 0;
            }

            @media only screen and (min-width: 480px) {
                #no-cdn-access dl,
                #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__contac-support,
                #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__actions-headlines {
                    padding: 0 250px;
                }
            }

            @media only screen and (min-width: 480px) and (min-height: 480px) {
                #no-cdn-access .headline__title {
                    margin-bottom: 100px;
                    font-size: 2.4rem;
                }
            }
        </style>
        <section class="headline">
            <span class="headline__title" role="heading">Due to a network error, some resources are not loading</span>
            <span class="headline__heading3"
                  role="heading">Sorry, some crucial files cannot be loaded at this time.</span>
            <p>If you can see two identical Namecheap logos below, please refresh the page and try again.</p>
        </section>
        <div class="no-cdn__logos">
            <div>
                <iframe src="https://files.namecheap.com/cdn/1157/assets/img/logos/namecheap.svg"
                        style="border: none;"></iframe>
            </div>
            <div>
                <iframe src="https://static.nc-img.com/namecheap.svg" style="border: none;"></iframe>
            </div>
        </div>
        <span class="no-cdn__actions-headlines" role="heading">If that doesn’t solve the problem, please follow these steps:</span>
        <dl>
            <dt>Whitelist Namecheap-owned domains on your local equipment.</dt>
            <dd>If you have a firewall or any other network block lists, please try to add the Namecheap-owned domains (<strong>*.namecheap.com</strong>
                and <strong>*.nc-img.com</strong>) to a whitelist on your local equipment.
            </dd>
            <dt>Ask your ISP to whitelist Namecheap-owned domains.</dt>
            <dd>If you see block notices that you are unaware of, try to get your ISP to unlock the Namecheap-owned
                domains (<strong>*.namecheap.com</strong> and <strong>*.nc-img.com</strong>). Alternatively, try
                reaching Namecheap resources via another provider, i.e., your mobile network or by VPN.
            </dd>
        </dl>
        <p class="no-cdn__contac-support">If you need any additional assistance, open <a href="/help-center/">Help
            Center</a> and contact support via live chat or open <a href="https://support.namecheap.com">Support
            page</a> and submit a ticket.</p>
    </script>

    <script type="text/html" id="no-cdn-access-content">
        <style>
            #no-cdn-access {
                padding-top: 24px;
                padding-bottom: 200px;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                color: #6d6e70;
                font-family: Museo Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;

                font-weight: 300;

                text-align: center;

            #no-cdn-access .headline__heading3 {

                font-size: 1.17em;
                margin-block-start: 1em;
                margin-block-end: 1em;
                margin-inline-start: 0;
                margin-inline-end: 0;
                font-weight: bold;
            }

            #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__logos {
                display: flex;
                flex: auto;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
            }

            #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__logos div {
                margin-right: 50px;
            }

            #no-cdn-access a, a:focus, a:hover {
                text-decoration: none;
            }

            #no-cdn-access p {
                margin: 0 0 1.5em;
            }

            #no-cdn-access .headline {
                font-size: 1.5rem;
                line-height: 1.33;
                text-align: center;
            }

            #no-cdn-access .headline__title {
                margin-bottom: 20px;
                font-size: 1.5rem;
                line-height: 1.125;
                font-weight: bold;
            }

            #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__actions-headlines {
                display: block;
                font-size: 1.5em;
                margin-block-start: 0.83em;
                margin-block-end: 0.83em;
                margin-inline-start: 0;
                margin-inline-end: 0;
                font-weight: bold;
            }

            #no-cdn-access dl,
            #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__contac-support,
            #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__actions-headlines {
                padding: 0 15px;
                text-align: left;
            }

            #no-cdn-access dl dt {
                font-weight: 600;
            }

            #no-cdn-access dl * {
                line-height: 1.8rem;
            }

            #no-cdn-access ul {
                margin: 0;
            }

            @media only screen and (min-width: 480px) {
                #no-cdn-access dl,
                #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__contac-support,
                #no-cdn-access .no-cdn__actions-headlines {
                    padding: 0 250px;

                #no-cdn-access .headline__title {
                    margin-bottom: 100px;
                    font-size: 2.4rem;

        <section class="headline">
            <span class="headline__title" role="heading">Due to a network error, some resources are not loading</span>
            <span class="headline__heading3"
                  role="heading">Sorry, some crucial files cannot be loaded at this time.</span>
            <p>If you can see two identical Namecheap logos below, please refresh the page and try again.</p>
        </section>
        <div class="no-cdn__logos">
            <div>
                <iframe src="https://files.namecheap.com/cdn/1157/assets/img/logos/namecheap.svg"
                        style="border: none;"></iframe>
            </div>
            <div>
                <iframe src="https://static.nc-img.com/namecheap.svg" style="border: none;"></iframe>
            </div>
        </div>
        <span class="no-cdn__actions-headlines" role="heading">If that doesn’t solve the problem, please follow these steps:</span>
        <dl>
            <dt>Whitelist Namecheap-owned domains on your local equipment.</dt>
            <dd>If you have a firewall or any other network block lists, please try to add the Namecheap-owned domains (<strong>*.namecheap.com</strong>
                and <strong>*.nc-img.com</strong>) to a whitelist on your local equipment.
            </dd>
            <dt>Ask your ISP to whitelist Namecheap-owned domains.</dt>
            <dd>If you see block notices that you are unaware of, try to get your ISP to unlock the Namecheap-owned
                domains (<strong>*.namecheap.com</strong> and <strong>*.nc-img.com</strong>). Alternatively, try
                reaching Namecheap resources via another provider, i.e., your mobile network or by VPN.
            </dd>
        </dl>
        <p class="no-cdn__contac-support">If you need any additional assistance, open <a href="/help-center/">Help
            Center</a> and contact support via live chat or open <a href="https://support.namecheap.com">Support
            page</a> and submit a ticket.</p>
